title: Semicircle law for multi-parameter random simplicial complexes
summary: In this paper, we consider the multi-parameter random simplicial complex model, which generalizes the Linial-Meshulam model and random clique complexes by allowing simplices of different dimensions to be included with distinct probabilities. For $n,d \in \mathbb{N}$ and $\mathbf{p}=(p_1,p_2,\ldots, p_d)\in (0,1]^d$, the multi-parameter random simplicial complex $Y_d(n,\mathbf{p})$ is constructed inductively.
